info.title: PatrolTech Public API
info.description:
Public subset of the PatrolTech API. Breaking changes require a major version bump.

Response envelope for `/api/*`: every JSON response is wrapped as
`{ success, message, data, meta? }`. The 2xx schemas below describe `data`.
Errors arrive as `{ success: false, message, data: null, meta }`, with the details
(`errorCode`, `code`...) in `meta` unless the handler emitted the envelope itself.
`/oauth/*` and `/.well-known/*` follow the OAuth RFCs: plain JSON, no envelope.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: `true` also lists the archived routes (#1283). By default they are left out.

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`.

400.description: `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION`: the checkpoint is not on the route's location (or does not exist). `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` (`data.checkpointIds`): the checkpoint is archived.

delete.description: The rounds in progress on the route are cancelled. Removing its last checkpoint deactivates the route (`isActive: false`): an empty route cannot be patrolled. Adding checkpoints back does not reactivate it.

post.description:
**TIMEZONE CONTRACT**: `startTime`/`endTime` are UTC `HH:MM` and `days`
are ISO weekdays in UTC. The client converts local time → UTC before
sending; the backend never converts them.

Send `timezone` (IANA, e.g. "Europe/Madrid") with the zone the times
were converted from: the backend stores it with the current UTC offset
and re-projects the UTC times at every DST change so the window keeps
its local time. Without it the window is never realigned. If the route
already has a stored zone, that one wins and the window's `timezone` is
ignored.

400.description: The new window overlaps one the route already has (#978): `code` is `TIME_WINDOWS_OVERLAP` and `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned when `timezone` is not a valid IANA zone, as a plain error whose `message` is `Invalid timezone: <zone>` (no `code`). Nothing is created.

get.summary: Get route with checkpoints and time windows

post.summary: Create route with checkpoints and time windows
post.description: Created active when it has checkpoints; without them (`checkpoints` empty or omitted) it is created inactive, whatever the body says: a route without checkpoints cannot be active.

400.description: Two of the submitted time windows overlap (#978). Nothing is created; `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned, with `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION` and `data: null`, when a checkpoint is not on the route's location, and with `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` and `data.checkpointIds` when a checkpoint is archived.

409.description: `code: LOCATION_ARCHIVED`: the location is archived (#1283). Nothing is created; restore the location first.

get.summary: Get the per-checkpoint scan breakdown for a route round
get.description:
Lists every checkpoint of the route (in route order) and whether it
was scanned during this specific round, with the scan time when it
was. Checkpoints are matched to scans by their POSITION in the route
(`order`), not by checkpoint id — a checkpoint can occupy more than
one slot in an ordered route.

patch.description: A route without checkpoints cannot be activated (400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`), nor an archived one (409 `ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: unarchive it first); deactivating it is always allowed.

400.description: `code: ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`: the route has no checkpoints and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

409.description: `code: ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: the route is archived and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

403.description: meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_CHANGE_IDENTITY: una sesión de agente MCP (via: 'mcp') no cambia los teléfonos de la cuenta (phone, whatsappPhone); solo la sesión del propio usuario. No se cambió nada (solo si el body trae whatsappPhone)

get.summary: Org-scoped support summary: rounds by status in a window, patroller headcount, checkpoint count and suspicious scans

200.description: Aggregated support summary for the organization

403.description: No VIEWER access to this organization

400.description: VERIFICATION_TYPE_RETIRED: the inline method is `manual_code`, which can no longer be created (#1301). Also VALIDATION_ERROR for a malformed body.

409.description: VERIFICATION_CODE_TAKEN: the chosen code is already used by a live checkpoint of the organization (body below). Also EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED on paid plans when the checkpoint adds a charge that needs confirming (`confirmExtraBilling`). LOCATION_ARCHIVED when its location is archived (#1283): nothing is created.

422.description: Invalid verificationMethod config for its type (e.g. a qr_static code over 1000 bytes) or a type not implemented yet

get.summary: Download the QR sheet PDF of a signed link
get.description: No Authorization header: the link is the credential. The sheet is rebuilt from the checkpoints as they are now, and the user the link was issued to must still be an active EDITOR of the location.

403.description: QR_SHEET_ACCESS_REVOKED: the user is no longer active or no longer an EDITOR of the location (errorCode in the response metadata)

410.description: QR_SHEET_LINK_INVALID: tampered, forged, expired, malformed or unknown link, always the same answer (errorCode in the response metadata)

422.description: NO_PRINTABLE_CHECKPOINTS: nothing printable is left; or QR_SHEET_TOO_LARGE: the location now has more than 600 printable checkpoints (errorCode in the response metadata)

423.description: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: the organization of the location is suspended. Same body as the panel 423; the link carries no session, so the suspension is checked here.

429.description: Too many downloads: 30 per minute per IP and 10 per minute per user; errorCode RATE_LIMITED

get.summary: List access history for a location
Get currently active entries (not yet exited)
Get full incident detail including timeline and media

patch.summary: Update the status of an incident

400.description: Invalid status transition or missing required comment

post.summary: Add a comment to an incident

patch.summary: Assign or unassign an incident to a user

400.description: Invalid body, or meta.errorCode ASSIGNEE_NOT_IN_ORGANIZATION: the assignee has no role in the incident's organization (#1312)

get.summary: Licencia, tier, consumo y opciones de upgrade de una organización
get.description: Abierto a VIEWER: límites y consumo son datos operativos. Los identificadores de Stripe y `billingCountry`/`currencyFixed` (datos de facturación) se omiten para quien no llega a EDITOR. `billing` (si factura, cada cuánto y en qué moneda) llega a todos: `currency` es la moneda en la que se PRECIA a la organización (también si aún no paga) y `billing.currency`, la de la suscripción que paga.

404.description: NO_LICENSE — la organización no tiene licencia

200.description: Server metadata; 404 when OAuth is disabled

get.summary: Public keys that verify the access tokens
Start the authorization code flow with PKCE S256

302.description: To the consent screen; once the client is trusted, a CIMD client gets its errors at its `redirect_uri` with `error`, `state` and `iss`

post.summary: Dynamic registration of a public client (RFC 7591)
Exchange an authorization code (PKCE) or rotate a refresh token
Exchange an OAuth access token for a short-lived user JWT (`via: mcp`) that calls `/api`

parameters.name: validationStatus

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Times stay UTC; this records which local time they came from so the backend can re-project them when the offset changes (DST).

windows.description: The two conflicting windows (UTC), in the order they were checked.

scheduleTimezone.description: IANA timezone the route schedule is expressed in, chosen by the user. Takes precedence over the stored one and over each window timezone: only a client that converted the times with it sends this field.

expectedVersion.description: The `version` the client loaded. If stale, the update is rejected with 409 so a concurrent edit is never silently overwritten.

isActive.description: Update only (ignored on create: a new route is active when it has checkpoints). A route without checkpoints cannot be active: saved with an empty list it is deactivated, and activating one without sending checkpoints is refused with 400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`. Anything but a boolean is refused with 400.

RouteArchiveConflict.description: 409 of creating, updating, deleting, archiving, unarchiving or activating a route (#1283). `code` is at the top level; LOCATION_ARCHIVED means the location of the route, or the one an update assigns to a route without one (#1318), is archived.

config.description: Per-type config. For `qr_static` and `manual_code`, `code` is a non-empty string; a `qr_static` code is printed as a QR, so it is at most 1000 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (longer is a config validation error).

address.description: `null` clears it (stored as an empty string).

UpdateLocationBody.description: Only name, address and city are applied; any other field is ignored.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in, or null for windows created before #995. Clients must edit the schedule in THIS timezone, not in the timezone of whoever opens the form: sending back a different one would re-label the route and shift it on the next DST change.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Offset in minutes applied when the local times were converted to UTC, or null. Recorded so the backend can re-project the window when the offset changes (DST, #995).

isFirstRoute.description: Only on create. True when this is the first route of the organization, decided atomically server-side (#937).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter. Send it back as `expectedVersion` on update (#936).

archivedAt.description: When the route was archived because it has history (#1283); null while in use. An archived route is inactive and left out of lists unless `includeArchived=true`.

oauthAccessToken.description: OAuth access token issued by POST /oauth/token
